title: List the tables and component keys of a DbLib
summary: Finds database libraries through the integrated library manager, lists their tables and, optionally, each table's component keys via GetAllComponentKeys with a caller-supplied IStrings list.
phrasings: read component keys from a database library
pass an IStrings list to an SDK call

commands.name: ListComponentKeys
commands.description: List the tables and component keys of a DbLib
commands.params: DbLib=<path to .DbLib> (optional, default: every available database library)|Keys=true (optional)|Max=<keys listed per table, default 5, 0 = all> (optional)
